scope:
Independent exact-source review of compact nineteen-board native integration.

Use the reviewed Serial62 archive as the immutable parent, not the builder's
expected strings. Only qualified compact assets, router name, schema, metadata
and removal of obsolete MSA hold cuts may change. Original pins/equations,
clocks/IO, macros and virtual service ownership are otherwise byte-identical.
source_contract: Exact reviewed parent with qualified compact assets, router name, schema and removal of obsolete hold cuts
limits: Source proof only; actual selected-source geometry, fit, timing and full snapshots are separate.
